2088724_f38ee4d2.text: Several cortical areas located within the medial TL, among others the piriform cortex, the amygdala, the entorhinal cortex as well as the hippocampal formation, have been linked to olfactory processing due to their close anatomical connectivity to the olfactory receptor neurons (Room et al., 1984)(Carmichael et al., 1994).
